description: This file defines the main search page component in a React-based frontend application. It imports React's Suspense component and a SearchClient component, and renders the client component within a Suspense boundary to handle loading states. The file serves as the entry point for the search page, enabling static rendering and client-side query handling.

methods.name: SearchPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the search page, wrapping the SearchClient component within Suspense for fallback during loading.
